services.name: Content Engine
services.promise: New content every week, in your voice and your brand. We make it.
services.forWho: Artists and businesses that need to post often and have neither the time nor the team to do it.

extra.title: What it is
extra.body: A monthly service: we study everything you already have (videos, songs, photos, old posts, the way you talk) and turn it into new pieces every week. You approve; we produce. It's not generic content: every piece comes from your material and respects your brand.

extra.title: How it works
body: Week 1, diagnosis: we review your social accounts and your material and build your brand summary (colors, typography, tone, themes)
Monthly calendar: we show you what goes out and when, and you approve it before we produce
Weekly production: edited or animated reels, carousels, stories, captions and hashtags
Approval: nothing gets published without your OK
End-of-month review: what worked and what we adjust

extra.title: What you get
body: Brand summary (1x, updated whenever something changes)
Monthly calendar approved by you
The plan's pieces every week, in 1080×1920 vertical and 1080×1350 feed format
Captions and hashtags ready to paste
Simple monthly report

extra.title: Piece examples
body: Artist: a reel with your song's lyrics, behind-the-scenes cuts, a countdown to release, a studio clip
Business: tips carousel, a video explaining a service, a reel of a happy client, the offer of the week

extra.title: Plans
body: Starter: 2 pieces per week
Basic: 5 pieces per week
Full: 15 pieces per week

extra.title: Content Engine vs Content Software
extra.body: With the Engine (D1), we make your content every week. With the Software (D2), we install the system on your team's computers so your people can do it.

services.name: Content Software
services.promise: The content system installed on your team's computers. Your people run it.
services.forWho: Businesses, labels or teams that want to produce their own content without depending on anyone.

extra.title: What it is
extra.body: The same system we use to run the Content Engine, installed on your team's computers and set up with your brand. Your team writes the idea, picks the template, and the system builds the piece with your colors, your typography and your tone.

extra.title: How it works
body: We review your computers, your social accounts and what kind of pieces you need
We install the system and load your brand
We create your templates: reels, carousels, stories and explainer videos
We train your team with your own real pieces
2 weeks of support while they get started

extra.title: What you get
body: System installed and running on your computers
Your brand loaded: colors, typography, logo and tone
Templates for your main formats
1 training session + step-by-step written guide
2 weeks of support

extra.title: What you need
body: A computer with Windows or Mac
AI service accounts if your team wants to use commercial options (you pay them directly)

extra.title: Example
extra.body: A label with 5 artists: each artist has their own release template, and the social media person pulls the whole week's pieces in one afternoon.

extra.title: Content Software vs Content Engine
extra.body: With the Software (D2), your team produces and you control everything. With the Engine (D1), we do it for you. You can start with D1 and move to D2 when your team is ready.
